mapper.update: update portal_user set deleted_flag = #{deletedFlag} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT activity.id AS activity_id, activity.title AS activity_title, activity.score_can_get AS score, activity_schedule.activity_end_time AS finish_time FROM activity_enrollment INNER JOIN activity ON activity.id = activity_enrollment.activity_id AND activity.deleted_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN activity_schedule ON activity_schedule.activity_id = activity_enrollment.activity_id WHERE activity_enrollment.user_id = #{userId} AND activity_enrollment.deleted_flag = 0 AND activity_enrollment.sign_in_status = 1 AND activity.status = 4 ORDER BY activity_schedule.activity_end_time DESC, activity.id DESC
